name: @wasm4pm/core
description: Process Mining in WebAssembly - High-Speed Algorithms for Browser and Node.js

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:web && npm run build:nodejs
scripts.build:profiles: npm run build:mobile && npm run build:iot && npm run build:edge && npm run build:fog && npm run build:browser
scripts.build:mobile: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features mobile && wasm-pack build --target bundler --release
scripts.build:iot: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features iot && wasm-pack build --target bundler --release
scripts.build:edge: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features edge && wasm-pack build --target bundler --release
scripts.build:fog: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features fog && wasm-pack build --target bundler --release
scripts.test:browser: npm run build:web && vitest run --browser chromium __tests__/benchmarks/browser.test.ts
scripts.bench:build: npm run build:nodejs && npm run bench
scripts.bench:browser: npm run build:web && vitest run --browser chromium __tests__/benchmarks/browser.test.ts
scripts.bench:browser:ci: npm run build:web && CI_MODE=true vitest run --browser chromium __tests__/benchmarks/browser.test.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build:all && npm run lint && npm run test

author: Sean Chatman <info@chatmangpt.com>
